items.title: 让初始化流程原生生成 Codex 所需产物
items.context: 新项目应自动获得 AGENTS、Codex agent 定义和使用说明，而不是靠后补。

happy.desc: koala init 生成的新项目 → 自动带有 AGENTS、.Codex/agents、.Codex/README 等 Codex 所需产物

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/codex-onboarding.json:4 — case runs koala init into a temp project and asserts AGENTS, .Codex/agents, .Codex/README, plus init output mentions, so the generated Codex onboarding surface is covered end-to-end | severity:info

edge.desc: 已有部分 Codex 文件时再次 init → 缺失项会补齐，已存在项不会被无提示覆盖

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/codex-onboarding.json:23 — case re-runs init after deleting one Codex asset and customizing README, then checks missing files are restored while existing content is skipped and preserved, covering partial-existing rerun behavior | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 只验证当前仓库、不验证 init 产物时 → 回归或 reviewer 能暴露“Codex 不是一等接入”的漏项

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/codex-onboarding.json:40 — case proves repo-level codex asset verification alone is not the only signal by also asserting a fresh init output contains Codex assets, so reviewer/regression would catch a first-class onboarding gap beyond current-repo hand checks | severity:info

items.title: 统一 Claude 与 Codex 的 agent 模板来源
items.context: 避免 .claude 和 .Codex 两套模板长期漂移，后续新增 reviewer/implementer 时成本过高。

happy.desc: Codex agent 定义由统一来源生成 → Claude 与 Codex 版本在结构上保持一致，只保留必要平台差异

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/codex-onboarding.json:56 — case runs test:codex-assets, whose verifier compares every .Codex agent file against the transformed .claude source, covering unified template generation for canonical output | severity:info

edge.desc: 新增或调整 agent 规则时 → transform 仍能正确反映平台差异而不产生明显漂移

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/codex-onboarding.json:71 — case calls renderCodexAgentContent on sample Claude wording and checks both platform-name and path substitutions, covering the transform layer that should preserve intended platform differences without drift | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 如果只手工复制一份模板、忘记同步另一份 → 自动生成或回归检查会暴露模板漂移风险

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/codex-onboarding.json:87 — case deliberately drifts .Codex/agents/test-intent.md and asserts test:codex-assets fails with an explicit drift message naming the file, so forgotten template sync is exposed by automated regression | severity:info

items.title: 补齐仓库首页和 Codex 侧入口说明
items.context: 让使用者从 README/AGENTS/.Codex 三个入口都能快速找到正确命令。

happy.desc: 使用者从 README、AGENTS、.Codex 三个入口都能找到一致的 Codex 使用方式

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/codex-onboarding.json:103 — case reads README, AGENTS.md, and .Codex/README.md and checks each entry surface advertises the expected Codex command path, covering aligned user-facing guidance across the three docs | severity:info

edge.desc: 没有本地 wrapper 的项目里 → 文案仍能指导用户走 KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex 的降级入口

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/codex-onboarding.json:120 — case inspects a freshly initialized .Codex/README and asserts it includes the KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE fallback while avoiding a hard wrapper-only requirement, covering no-wrapper projects | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 某一层文档遗漏或口径不一致时 → 回归验证能拦住错误入口说明进入发布面

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/codex-onboarding.json:136 — case intentionally introduces .Codex/README fallback drift and asserts test:codex-assets fails with a targeted message, covering regression protection against bad Codex entry-surface docs reaching release | severity:info
